practiceReport.name: Josh Jacobs
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (RB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
factors: Officially ruled Out on weekly game status report
practiceReport.beatComment: Coming out of the Packers' Week 11 bye, head coach Matt LaFleur told Matt Schneidman of The Athletic on Saturday that he didn't expect Jacobs to play in Week 12, but he also gave the running back a "chance to prove" he can. Jacobs then was listed as limited on practice reports Sunday through Tuesday and tagged as questionable ahead of Wednesday's game. Such activity wasn't enough for Jacobs to get the all clear to suit up, meaning Green Bay's backfield will be manned by Kaleb Johnson, MarShawn Lloyd and Chris Brooks for a second consecutive contest.

practiceReport.name: Zaire Franklin
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (9th NFL season, 99% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
factors: Officially ruled Out on weekly game status report
practiceReport.beatComment: Franklin drew the questionable tag for Wednesday's game following three consecutive limited practices. However, the veteran linebacker will end up missing a fifth consecutive game due to a hairline fracture in his shin that he suffered during a practice session in late October, so Ty'Ron Hopper will continue to operate in an elevated role on defense. Franklin's next opportunity to play is Week 13 against the Saints on Sunday, Dec. 6.

practiceReport.name: Christian Watson
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (77% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Remains in early stages of NFL 5-Step Concussion Protocol
practiceReport.beatComment: The wideout hasn't cleared concussion checks and will miss the remainder of the Week 12 contest after he was injured at the end of the second quarter when Watson took a hit to the head from Kamren Kinchens. Look for J. Michael Sturdivant and Bo Melton to see increased snaps alongside Matthew Golden and Savion Williams with Watson sidelined.

practiceReport.name: Barryn Sorrell
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (78%)
practiceReport.beatComment: Prior to leaving, the linebacker recorded four tackles (two solo). Dani Dennis-Sutton and Brenton Cox will see an uptick in snaps off the edge for Green Bay.

practiceReport.name: Micah Parsons
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Explosive pass rusher who regularly manages mid-week reps and plays high-leverage third-down snaps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported Monday that Parsons gained clearance to return to action, but first the Packers needed to activate him from the reserve/PUP list, which came to pass Tuesday. Parsons was listed as questionable ahead of Wednesday's matchup, and he's now ready for his first game since Dec. 14, 2025, when he tore the ACL and meniscus in his left knee. Tom Pelissero of Netflix reported Wednesday that Parsons will play approximately 50 percent of the defensive snaps in his season debut.

practiceReport.name: Sean Rhyan
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (87% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Rhyan suffered a high ankle sprain against the Lions in Week 7, which sidelined him for the Packers' following three games. He's been cleared by medical staff to play Wednesday, and Rhyan will reclaim his starting spot at center while John Williams reverts to a depth role.

practiceReport.name: Skyy Moore
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (WR) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Moore aggravated an ankle injury against the Vikings in Week 10, but the fifth-year pro has been cleared to play Wednesday after going through pregame warmups. Moore has mostly operated on special teams as a returner this season and has not caught a catch since Week 5 against the Bears.

practiceReport.name: Brandon Cisse
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (83% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: The Packers' rookie cornerback is ready to go for Wednesday's game against the Rams after he exited Week 10 early against the Vikings. Cisse has started all 10 games this season, recording 38 tackles (26 solo), including 1.5 sacks, and nine pass breakups, including an interception, on 83 percent of the defensive snaps.

practiceReport.name: Kevin Zeitler
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (G) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Zeitler was unable to play against the Vikings in Week 10 due to triceps and ankle injuries, but the veteran offensive lineman has been cleared to play Wednesday. He should start at right guard while Travis Glover provides depth at the position.

practiceReport.name: Travis Glover
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (100% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Glover's practice reps were limited due to a shoulder injury, but the third-year pro was given the green light by medical staff to play Wednesday. He's started in five regular-season games, most recently in Week 10 against the Vikings, but he'll likely operate in a depth role at right guard behind starter Kevin Zeitler.

practiceReport.name: Bo Melton
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (WR) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Melton's practice reps were limited due to a thigh injury he picked up against the Vikings in Week 10, but the 2022 seventh-rounder has been cleared by medical staff to suit up Wednesday. He has five catches on 10 targets for 34 yards through 10 regular-season games but has not recorded a reception since Week 7 against the Lions.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Josh Whyle
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 11 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Whyle suffered a concussion in Week 8 against Carolina and missed last Sunday's win over the Patriots. He had already been ruled for Sunday's contest against Minnesota before the Packers decided to place him on IR. Whyle didn't log a catch or target during his eight contests before getting hurt, so his blocking and work on special teams will be the primary voids during his absence.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Collin Oliver
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Oliver must miss at least the first four games of the regular season on injured reserve before he is eligible to return to the Packers' active roster. This minimum timeframe appears to align well with the linebacker's injury, and the 2025 fifth-rounder should return from IR and suit up shortly after the four-game period ends.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Jacob Monk
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 11 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: A fifth-round pick in 2024, Monk started the first three games of the season at right guard and was called upon to man center Sunday against the Lions after Sean Rhyan exited with an ankle injury. With Rhyan out multiple weeks and Monk slated to miss at least four games, the Packers will likely turn to John Williams at center after he came on to play the first 58 offensive snaps of his career against Detroit on Sunday.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Jonathan Ford
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Ford emerged from this past Sunday's win over Chicago with a calf injury and didn't practice at all this week. He's now slated to miss a minimum of four contests while on IR. Ford has been working in a rotational role along Green Bay's defensive line this season and has amassed five tackles, including 0.5 sacks, through five contests.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Warren Brinson
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 11 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Brinson suffered a calf injury during the preseason that forced him to miss the Packers' first three regular-season games before he was ultimately sent to injured reserve in early October. LaFleur also said Thursday that Brinson is recovering from a groin surgery, which could be a factor in his extended absence. Until he comes back from IR, Anthony Campbell figures to continue to see increased reps on the defensive line in his stead.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Edgerrin Cooper
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Cooper suffered a torn Achilles in Sunday's win over the Buccaneers, and he will now spend the rest of the season on IR. In his absence, Zaire Franklin and Isaiah McDuffie will operate as the team's primary options at inside linebacker.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Javon Hargrave
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Hargrave suffered a season-ending torn Achilles in last Sunday's win over the Bears, so this move is a mere formality. Green Bay's defense continues to be hit by injuries, as the unit awaits Micah Parsons' (knee) season debut. Chris McClellan and Anthony Campbell (ankle) will be next up for heavier snap loads up front on the defensive line.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Jayden Reed
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Reed remains without a clear timeline for a return after sustaining a neck injury that resulted in a brief stay in the hospital in the Packers' Week 2 win over the Jets, but his impending move to IR ensures that he'll remain out for at least Green Bay's next four games. With Reed out indefinitely, second-year player Matthew Golden should be further insulated as the Packers' No. 2 receiver, while the likes of Skyy Moore, Bo Melton and J. Michael Sturdivant should see more involvement in three- and four-wide sets.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Johnathan Baldwin II
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026

irAndReserveTracker.name: Luke Musgrave
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: LaFleur acknowledged that Musgrove is still in the process of rehabbing the neck injury he sustained during OTAs in June, and the Packers haven't yet prepared for the tight end to resume practicing. Barring dramatic progress in his recovery over the next month, Musgrave looks like he'll be sidelined for the final season of his rookie deal before hitting free agency in the spring.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Zach Bako-Bewele
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Bako-Bewele sustained a complete tear of his right patellar tendon in the Packers' Week 2 overtime win over the Jets. The right tackle is out for the season and has thus been placed on injured reserve. Laken Tomlinson is the new reserve offensive lineman for the team, and Anthony Belton is expected to be the starting right tackle for the remainder of the 2026 season.
